name: Default

toolbar.name: toolbar
toolbar.description: Custom toolbar configuration for the editor

fullToolbar.name: fullToolbar
fullToolbar.description: Editor full toolbar

server.name: server
server.description: Server configuration including upload type (crucial for each app context)

hasPreview.name: hasPreview
hasPreview.description: Enable editor preview

multilingual.name: multilingual
multilingual.description: Enables multilingual support, if true, the editor will be able to handle multiple languages, the language will be detected automatically based on merchant supported languages

format.name: format
format.description: Output format of the editor content

showCount.name: showCount
showCount.description: Show a live `current/max` character counter below the editor. Requires `max`. Counter follows the document direction so it stays anchored when the editor's own dir flips for per-language RTL. Turns danger-red under `has-error`.

productEmbed.name: productEmbed
productEmbed.description: Enable product embeds in the editor. Pass true for the default products API, or an object with endpoint (and optional searchParam / transform).

demoImagePicker.name: demoImagePicker
demoImagePicker.description: Story-only. Wires a stub `imagePicker` so the toolbar image button opens it instead of the native file picker. `imagePicker` itself is a function prop and has no Storybook control.

aiSuggestion.name: aiSuggestion
aiSuggestion.description: AI suggestion config (object or JSON string): { enabled, regenerable, source }. When `enabled`, the editor gets the Moshammer AI highlight and overlays the `actions` slot (regenerate / dismiss) at the top of the content area.

hideToolbar.name: hideToolbar
hideToolbar.description: Render the editor without its toolbar. Also moves the `end` slot in flow, since there is no toolbar row left to overlay.

startSlot.name: startSlot
startSlot.description: HTML projected into the `start` slot — a leading icon beside the editor body. Same contract as s-input / s-textarea: pass the element itself (no wrapper), and the component supplies `text-xl text-dark-100`.

endSlot.name: endSlot
endSlot.description: HTML projected into the `end` slot — trailing chrome such as a language dropdown. Overlaid on the toolbar's trailing edge, or in flow at the end of the body when `hideToolbar` is set. Set `multilingual` (or let the component detect the slot) to reserve the strip it sits over.

description.story:
`imagePicker` is an optional `() => Promise<string[] | void>`. When set, the toolbar image button calls it instead of opening the native file input, and the resolved URLs are inserted as images at the cursor — so a consumer can front the button with a media gallery instead of an upload.

This story wires a stub picker: **OK** resolves two sample images, **Cancel** resolves nothing and leaves the content untouched. It resolves after a delay on purpose — a real gallery is a modal that blurs the editor first, which is why the selection is captured before the picker opens.

Leave the prop unset and the editor keeps the native upload flow unchanged. Being a function, `imagePicker` is set as a DOM property (`el.imagePicker = fn`), never as an attribute.

title: Components/Rate
name: Default

readOnly.name: readOnly
readOnly.description: Enable this if you want to make the rate read only

size.name: size
size.description: Rate size, you can choose between `sm`, `md` and `lg`

iconStyle.name: iconStyle
iconStyle.description: Icon style for the rating. `star` uses the classic star icons; `emoji` uses expressive face icons (angry → sad → neutral → happy → star-face).

onRateChanged.name: onRateChanged
onRateChanged.description: Emitted when the rating value changes. In `star` mode the payload contains `{ value, maxStars, totalRate }`; in `emoji` mode it contains `{ value, emoji }` where `emoji` is the selected HugeIcons class (e.g. `hgi-solid hgi-smile`).

rateChanged.name: rateChanged
rateChanged.description: Emitted when a star or emoji is clicked, providing the new value and mode-specific payload.

description.component: The s-rate component represents a rating system that allows users to provide or view ratings. It supports two icon styles: `star` (classic half-star capable stars) and `emoji` (5 expressive face icons: angry → confused → neutral → happy → star-face). In emoji mode the value is always a whole number (1–5) and the `rateChanged` payload contains the selected emoji icon class instead of maxStars/totalRate.

multiselect.name: multiselect
multiselect.description: Enables multiple selection mode, you can then choose either tags or count of selected items, count is default

selectAll.name: selectAll
selectAll.description: Shows a select-all row in the dropdown. Works only when multiselect is enabled.

readonly.name: readonly
readonly.description: The value cannot change, but the component stays usable: the dropdown still opens and closes, and the search box still filters. Selecting, select-all, add-new, drawer navigation, the clear button and tag removal are all locked. Use it for async work that must not be interrupted, or for view-only permissions; unlike `disabled`, it never greys out the whole component or force-closes the overlay.

hideClearButton.name: hideClearButton
hideClearButton.description: Hide the clear button, useful in certain cases

confirmable.name: confirmable
confirmable.description: Buffers the selection behind sticky confirm/cancel actions at the end of the dropdown. No `selectChange` is emitted while the dropdown is open — confirm emits it once (plus `selectConfirm`), cancel emits `selectCancel` and restores the value the dropdown opened with.

overlayAlignment.name: overlayAlignment
overlayAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment preference for the dropdown overlay

sheetTitle.name: sheetTitle

cancelLabel.name: cancelLabel
cancelLabel.description: Label of the cancel action. Defaults to the translated "Cancel".

layout.description: Layout mode for the select dropdown

allowParentSelect.name: allowParentSelect

endSlot.name: endSlot
endSlot.description: HTML content to render in the end slot

toggleSlot.name: toggleSlot

selectChange.description: Emitted when the value of the select component changes.

title: Components/Select
name: Confirmable Actions

autocomplete.name: autocomplete

multiselect.name: multiselect
multiselect.description: Enables multiple selection mode, you can then choose either tags or count of selected items, count is default

selectAll.name: selectAll
selectAll.description: Shows a select-all row in the dropdown. Works only when multiselect is enabled.

readonly.name: readonly
readonly.description: The value cannot change, but the component stays usable: the dropdown still opens and closes, and the search box still filters. Selecting, select-all, add-new, drawer navigation, the clear button and tag removal are all locked. Use it for async work that must not be interrupted, or for view-only permissions; unlike `disabled`, it never greys out the whole component or force-closes the overlay.

hideClearButton.name: hideClearButton

confirmable.name: confirmable
confirmable.description: Buffers the selection behind sticky confirm/cancel actions at the end of the dropdown. No `selectChange` is emitted while the dropdown is open — confirm emits it once (plus `selectConfirm`), cancel emits `selectCancel` and restores the value the dropdown opened with.

This is the tooltip content that provides helpful information to users.

Click here to learn more

toggle.name: toggle
toggle.description: `toggle` slot, raw HTML for the trigger element, it must carry `slot="toggle"`. Any element works: `s-button`, `s-avatar`, `s-tag`, an icon or plain inline text.

- `title`: the tooltip heading, it is bolded by the component.
- default: the tooltip body, it accepts any markup, including `<s-tooltip-action>` actions.

args.content:
Setting the right cost price

To set an accurate cost price you have to add up every fixed and variable expense tied to the product, otherwise you end up with hidden losses.

  • Base purchase price: the amount you pay the supplier or the factory per unit.
  • Shipping and import: international shipping, customs and taxes, divided by the number of units.
  • Packaging materials: the carton, the tape and the labels of a single unit.
Products Cost price Cost calculation

description.component: Uploader component allows users to upload files with various layouts and configurations. It supports drag & drop, multiple files, file type restrictions, and preview functionality.
description.story: Extra actions slotted via `slot="actions"` render inline with the browse button; the consumer handles their clicks. Add `hide-browse-button` to keep only the slotted actions — drag & drop stays active, and a slotted action can open the picker through the `browse()` method. On desktop the whole drop zone is clickable; on mobile only the browse button (or a consumer action calling `browse()`) opens the picker. Both the actions row and the browse button live in the `thumbnail` layout only.
